## Data analysis

Descriptive data are presented as mean and standard deviations (SD). 

Bayesian models were constructed using the Stan probabilistic programming language [@stanpaper] and fitted using the `cmdstanr` interface [@cmdstanr] in R [@R]. All sampling from the prior and joint posterior distribution was done using the Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) no-U-turn sampler ([Stan Reference Manual: MCMC sampling](https://mc-stan.org/docs/reference-manual/mcmc.html)). A general workflow was adopted where models were incrementally built and tested for validity through simulations. First, implications of prior distributions were evaluated using prior predictive simulations. Priors where selected to constrain model predictions and parameter values to *a priori* plausible ranges. Samples from the joint posterior distribution where used to create posterior predictive checks where model implications where simulated and compared to observed data [@gelman2014, pp. 141].
Performance of the HMC algorithm was assessed by inspecting chain convergence statistics (R-hat) and visually inspecting convergence and stationary sampling across multiple HMC chains.   

## Description of the data set

The overall objective of the present analysis is to determine the effect of N-3 supplementation in combination with resistance training on indications of metabolic health. Main outcome variables in the this analysis are:

- Metabolic syndrome (with sub-scores) (primary)
   * Triglycerides
   * Waist circumference
   * Blood pressure 
   * HDL Cholesterol
   * Resting glucose
- Body mass index
- Relative fat mass
- HOMA2-IR
- OGTT

```{r}
#| label: tbl-participants
#| tbl-cap: "Participant characteristics."



part <- AOData::idkeys  
  
## Descriptives data 
baseline_dat <- AOData::bodycomp |>
  select(participant, time, lean.whole, BMC.whole, fat.whole)  |>
  mutate(weight = lean.whole + BMC.whole + fat.whole) |>
  inner_join(part) |>
  filter(time == "T1") |>
  ## Calculate height based on weight (DXA) and BMI 
  mutate(height = 100 * sqrt((weight/1000) / bmi)) |>
  ## Calculate relative lean and fat
  mutate(lean.rel = 100 * (lean.whole / weight), 
         fat.rel = 100 * (fat.whole/weight), 
         # Weight in kg
         weight = weight / 1000) |>
  select(participant, 
         treat, 
         completed, 
         sex, 
         age, 
         height, 
         weight, 
         bmi) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = age:bmi)
  
  
## Included participants
```

To assess if the outcome variables predict drop-out we fit a logistic regression model with drop-out ($D_i$) at time $\text{Time}$ T2 or T4, coded as 0/1 as the outcome variable. The association between the standardized measurement type value ($X_{i[A]}$) and drop-out was determined while controlling for sex ($S$) within each treatment group ($T$).

$$
\begin{align}
D_{i[\text{Time}]} &\sim \operatorname{Bernoulli}(p_i) \\
\operatorname{Logit}(p_i) &= \alpha_{[A]} + \beta_{X[A]} X_{i[A]} + \beta_{S[A]} S_i + \beta_{T[A]} T_i + \beta_{TX[A]} T_i X_i \\
\alpha_{[A]} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 0.5) \\
\beta_{X[A]} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 0.5) \\
\beta_{S[A]} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 0.5) \\
\beta_{T[A]} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 0.5) \\
\beta_{TX[A]} &\sim \operatorname{Normal}(0, 0.5) 
\end{align}
$$






```{r}
#| label: missing-data-prep


miss_dat <- criteria_dat |> 
  select(- threshold, -crit) |> 
  # Filter for time-point 1
  filter(time == "T1") |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = analyte, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = age:HOMA2IR, 
               values_to = "value", 
               names_to = "analyte")  |> 
    mutate(.by = analyte, 
         value_std = if_else(analyte %in% c("TG", "HOMA2IR"), log(value), value), 
         value_std = (value_std - mean(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(value_std, na.rm = TRUE)) 

## For mean-centering 
baseline_cent <- miss_dat |> 
  summarise(.by = analyte, 
            m = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            s = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            nas = sum(is.na(value_std)), 
            n = n()) |> 
  mutate(nas = nas / n) 


miss_dat2 <- miss_dat |> 
  filter(!is.na(value_std)) |> 
  # Missing at follow-up
  mutate(
    miss_t4 = if_else(participant %in% participant_complete_T4, 0, 1), 
    miss_t2 = if_else(participant %in% participant_complete_T2, 0, 1), 
    P = dense_rank(participant), 
    A = dense_rank(analyte), 
    TX= if_else(treat == "ctrl", -0.5, 0.5), 
    S = if_else(sex == "m", -0.5, 0.5),
  ) 
  
  
# Prepare list for model 
d <- list(
  N = nrow(miss_dat2), 
  N_A = length(unique(miss_dat2$A)), 
  N_P = length(unique(miss_dat2$P)), 
  N_TX =length(unique(miss_dat2$TX)), 
  N_S = length(unique(miss_dat2$S)), 
  # Indicators
  P = miss_dat2$P,           # Participant
  A = miss_dat2$A,           # Outcome/Analyte
  TX= miss_dat2$TX,          # Treatment
  
  # Predictors
  S = miss_dat2$S,           # sex
  x = miss_dat2$value_std,   # outcome std value
  do4 = miss_dat2$miss_t4,   # Drop-out to T4 
  do2 = miss_dat2$miss_t2,    # Drop-out to T2
  
  prior_only = 1
  
)
```


```{r}
#| label: model1-fit
#| output: false

# Compiling the model
m1 <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "models/m1.stan", 
                      exe_file = "models/m1.exe")



fit_wrap(m1,fit = "fit.m1", DATA = d)

```


In addition to measurements included in the metabolic syndrome diagnostic criteria (Fasting glucose, waist circumference, HDL, triglycerides, mean arterial blood pressure), we also included relative fat mass, body mass index, age and insulin resistance index (HOMA2IR).

Prior predictive checks (@fig-dropout-priorpredictive) confirmed that the model expects nine measurement types in two treatment groups and that the combined priors weakly regularize away from all/non drop-out.


```{r}
#| label: fig-dropout-priorpredictive
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-cap: "Prior predictive simulation for model 1. Columns are values of the predictor (SD-units) rows represents each predictor."


draws.m1 <- fit.m1$draws(format = "df")


draws.m1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("alpha2", "beta2"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "A"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  mutate(A = gsub("\\]", "", A)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  # Adding predictor variables
  expand_grid(x = seq(from = -3, to = 3, by = 3), 
                TX = c(-0.5, 0.5)) |>
  
  mutate(log_odds = alpha2 + beta2_x * x + beta2_tx * TX + beta2_xtx * TX * x, 
         prob = plogis(log_odds)) |> 
  mutate(Treatment = if_else(TX == -0.5, "Placebo", "N-3")) |> 
  ggplot(aes(prob, color = Treatment)) + 
  geom_line(stat = "density") +
  facet_grid( A ~ x ) +
  labs(x = "Drop-out probability", 
       y = "Prior density") +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), 
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = colscale)

  
```



```{r}
#| output: false
#| label: m1-posterior-fit

d$prior_only <- 0
fit_wrap(m1, fit = "fit.m1p", DATA = d)
draws.m1 <- fit.m1p$draws(format = "df")

```


```{r}
#| label: fig-dropout-across

a <- draws.m1 |>

  # Adding predictor variables
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dropout
#| tbl-cap: "Change in log-odds (Slope) for drop-out for 1 SD-unit change in baseline characteristic (Outcome) and differences in slope between treatment groups (&Delta Treatment) at time T2 and time T4. Values are posterior means with 95% percentile intervals."


draws.m1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  select(.iteration, starts_with("beta")) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("beta"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "A"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  mutate(A = gsub("\\]", "", A)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, 
              values_from = value) |> 

  mutate(
    avg_t2 = beta2_x,   # avg log odds effect of baseline t2
    avg_t4 = beta4_x,   # avg log odds ... t4
    txd_t2 = beta2_xtx, # diff in slope between tx groups t2
    txd_t4 = beta4_xtx, # diff in slope between tx groups t2
      ) |> 
  
    select(A, avg_t2:txd_t4) |> 
    pivot_longer(cols = avg_t2:txd_t4) |> 
  
  
  summarise(.by = c(A, name), 
            mlo = mean(value), 
            lwr = quantile(value, 0.025), 
            upr = quantile(value, 0.975)) |> 
  
  mutate(stat = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", round(mlo, 2)), 
                       " [", 
                       sprintf("%.2f", round(lwr, 2)), 
                       ", ", 
                       sprintf("%.2f", round(upr, 2)), 
                       "]"), 
         A = as.integer(A)) |> 
  dplyr::select(A, name, stat) |> 
  inner_join(
    miss_dat2 |> 
      distinct(A, analyte) |> 
      mutate(
        Outcome = case_when(
          analyte == "age" ~ "Age (years)", 
          analyte == "waist" ~ "Waist circumference (cm)", 
          analyte == "glucose" ~ "Resting glucose (mmol L<sup>-1</sup>)" ,
          analyte == "bp" ~ "Blood pressure (MAP)", 
          analyte == "TG" ~ "Triglycerides (log mmol L<sup>-1</sup>)",
          analyte == "HDL" ~ "HDL Cholesterol (mmol L<sup>-1</sup>)", 
          analyte == "fat.rel" ~ "Relative fat mass (%)", 
          analyte == "bmi" ~ "Body mass index (kg m<sup>-2</sup>)",
          analyte == "HOMA2IR" ~ "Insulin resistance index (log)")))|>  
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, 
              values_from = stat) |> 
  dplyr::select(Outcome, avg_t2, txd_t2, avg_t4, txd_t4) |> 
  gt() |> 
  fmt_markdown(columns = Outcome) |> 
  tab_spanner(label = "T2", 
              columns = c(avg_t2, txd_t2)) |> 
  tab_spanner(label = "T4", 
              columns = c(avg_t4, txd_t4)) |> 
  cols_label(
    avg_t2 = "Slope",
    txd_t2 = md("&Delta; Treatment"), 
    avg_t4 = "Slope",
    txd_t4 = md("&Delta; Treatment")
    ) |> 
  opt_table_font( font = list(
      google_font(name = "Merriweather"),
      "Cochin", "serif"
    ), 
    size = 10)
  
```

Age was negatively associated with probability of drop-out at T2 with now robust difference between treatment groups (@fig-dropout-across A; @tbl-dropout). Resting glucose at baseline tended to predict drop-out to T4 with no strong difference between treatment groups (@fig-dropout-across B; @tbl-dropout).


```{r}
#| label: fig-dropout-treat
#| include: false
#| eval: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-cap: "Effects of one SD-uniut change in baseline value on log-odds probability of droup-out per treatment group. Estimates are adjusted for sex, intervals are 90% percentile interval."

draws.m1 |> 
  filter(.chain == 1) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("alpha", "beta"))) |> 
  separate(name, into = c("param", "A"), sep = "\\[") |> 
  mutate(A = gsub("\\]", "", A), 
         time = if_else(grepl("4", param), "T4", "T2"), 
         param = gsub("[0-9]", "", param)) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, 
              values_from = value) |> 
  # Adding predictor variables
  expand_grid(x = seq(from = -3, to = 3, by = 0.1), 
                TX = c(-0.5, 0.5)) |>
  
  mutate(log_odds = beta_x + beta_xtx * TX , 
         prob = plogis(log_odds), 
         Treatment = if_else(TX == -0.5, "Placebo", "N-3")) |> 
  
  summarise(.by = c(A, Treatment, time), 
            mprob = mean(log_odds), 
            lwr = quantile(log_odds, 0.05), 
            upr = quantile(log_odds, 0.95)) |> 
    inner_join(
    miss_dat2 |> 
  distinct(A, analyte) |> 
  mutate(
    
    A = as.character(A),
    
    Outcome = case_when(
    analyte == "age" ~ "Age (years)", 
    analyte == "waist" ~ "Waist circumference (cm)", 
    analyte == "glucose" ~ "Resting glucose (mmol L<sup>-1</sup>)" ,
    analyte == "bp" ~ "Blood pressure (MAP)", 
    analyte == "TG" ~ "Triglycerides (log mmol L<sup>-1</sup>)", 
    analyte == "HDL" ~ "HDL Cholesterol (mmol L<sup>-1</sup>)", 
    analyte == "fat.rel" ~ "Relative fat mass (%)", 
    analyte == "bmi" ~ "Body mass index (kg m<sup>-2</sup>)",
    analyte == "HOMA2IR" ~ "Insulin resistance index (log)")) |> 
  inner_join(
    baseline_cent
   )
  ) |> 
 
  ggplot(aes(Treatment, mprob, 
             ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, 
             color = time)) + 
  geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.2)) + 
  facet_wrap(~ Outcome) +
    theme(strip.text = element_markdown()) + 
  labs(x = "", 
       y = "Log-odds change in drop-out probability\nper SD-unit change in predictor")
```
